title: Pre-Qualification Letter Age and the Builder Extended Rate Lock Upfront Fee
content:
A pre-qualification letter that has aged before the lock request adds points to the upfront fee percent of a Builder Extended Rate Lock, more for a lower qualifying credit score.

**Standard.** The letter age is the calendar days from the pre-qualification letter date on the converted Homesite Reservation to the lock request date. A letter age above 30 days with a qualifying credit score below 720 adds 0.125 percentage points to the upfront fee percent; a letter age above 30 days with a qualifying credit score of 720 or higher adds 0.0625 percentage points; any other lock adds nothing. The points are added to the upfront fee percent before it is applied to the loan amount on the lock.

## Grid

| | Qualifying credit score below 720 | Qualifying credit score 720 or higher |
|---|---|---|
| Letter age above 30 days | add 0.125 | add 0.0625 |
| Letter age 30 days or fewer | nothing | nothing |

The letter date is read from the Homesite Reservation that converted into the purchase agreement the lock finances; the request date and the qualifying credit score from the lock record.

## Cases (hypothetical dates, letter dated 1 April)

- Lock requested 1 May: letter age 30 days, nothing added.
- Lock requested 2 May: letter age 31 days; with a score of 705, 0.125 added; with a score of 720, 0.0625 added.
